title: Specify and parse COOP and COEP report-to parameters as token or string
body:
- In § 7.1.3.1 and § 7.1.4.1 prose, replace "valid URL string" with token, clarifying that report-to names an endpoint rather than a URL.
- In COOP and COEP algorithms, accept either a token or a string for backwards compatibility with deployed headers and existing implementations.

Fixes https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11365
See also https://github.com/WICG/document-policy/issues/47
